What this narrows down
- Comments: the sticky anchor's field 2 (color) is what triggers invalidUTF8 — sticky with
  fields 1,3,5,6 imports (08n); sticky with 1,2 fails (08o); full sticky fails (08k). GoodNotes
  must declare field 2 as a string. Comment records themselves are fine when wrapped (08l).
- Audio refs: the map encoding is right (10h, 10i both land and project exactly like real
  notes). Real notes key the map by a per-reference uuid with {timestampFlicks, pageId}, as 10i.

Your real library (read-only)
- audioNote: 35 real audio notes with non-empty references (plus 5 real ones with "{}").
  All in the same shape: {"values":{<ref uuid>:{"timestampFlicks":"…","pageId":"…"}}};
  a few refs have pageId only (no timestampFlicks).
- comment_thread / comment: none in the real library (only my test imports). No
  commentThreadCreated (130) or commentCreated (133) events exist anywhere in
  events_main.db's SSTs, so there are no real comment bytes to compare against.
- Raw events: Library/Databases/events_main.db is RocksDB (BlockBased, LZ4). Copied to scratch
  and walked with a small read-only SST reader; keys are agg!<aggregateId>!<seq>, values are
  Event{1 aggregateId, N body}. Across the SSTs: 43 audioNoteCreated (160, incl. a few from my test imports), 572
  audioNoteReferencesUpdated (161), 1 audioNoteRenamed (164).
  Decoded real audioNoteCreated body: 1 audioId, 2 attachmentId, 3 documentId,
  4 durationFlicks (varint), 5 references = message{ repeated 1 = entry{1: ref uuid string,
  2: {1: timestampFlicks varint, 2: pageId string}} }, 6 position (12 08 08 01 10 …),
  10 timestamp double, 11 event id, 12 userId, 13 replicaId, 14 logical_timestamp, 15 schemaVersion=24.
  Real audioNoteRenamed body 3 = {1: "Audio Clip 1", 2: {1: 1, 2: clock}} -> the name is an
  LWW with value in field 1; our 10h/10i projection rows have only the clock part.
